_comment: What the core holds that is worth keeping, and for how long: the same
declaration an application makes in its application.json, read by the
safety officer before anything is destroyed (scripts/details/holds).
Both are a site's own, worth keeping while the site lives, so neither
stands in the way of the site's teardown. The state lives on machines'
own disks and is kept by its replicas; the history lives on the node,
on a volume that is attached to whichever machine needs it.
